crossRefs.note: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
translations.bsb: Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, will enter it. Encourage him, for he will enable Israel to inherit the land.
translations.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit
translations.asv: Joshua the son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage thou him; for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
